title: Taikyoku Shougi: Kiwame II
overview:
The authentic shogi software that prides itself on strength and speed is powered up with the latest joseki data and a full set of features!

Packed with new features to raise your shogi skill!
- The strongest thinking routine in PC shogi, now with the latest opening data
- Versus tsume shogi that handles any reply
- Includes 300 tsume shogi problems, 300 next-move problems, and 150 artistic tsume problems

「強さ」と「速さ」を誇る本格派将棋ソフトが最新の定跡データと機能充実でパワーアップ！

棋力アップのための新機能が満載！
・パソコン将棋最強の思考ルーチンに最新定跡データを搭載
・どんな応じ手にも対応する対戦詰将棋搭載
・詰将棋300題、次の一手300題、鑑賞曲詰集150題収録
